intro: Supplies from Darkshire is an Alliance quest in Duskwood where the hermit Abercrombie asks passing travelers to run an errand to Darkshire on his behalf. Claiming to be too frail to make the dangerous trek through the haunted forest, he seeks a rare material known as Ghost Hair Thread from Madame Eva.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, what is a poor old man to do? I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.
Can you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread? You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Ghost Hair Thread is what you need, is it? I'm afraid I have none in stock, but I can make some for you...if you can supply the ghost hair.
